snippet.title: Infinicrypt - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Take control of one of 3 mighty heroes to vanquish an evil as old as time. Dodge attacks, slay monsters, and collect items in this bullet-hell dungeon-delving roguelike! Are you ready for the infinite depths? An evil lich as old as time itself lurks beneath the earth in ever-shifting halls. There they wait, building their horde of undead so that they may rule the world once again... Before the lich can enact their plan, mighty heroes rise to face the most infamous dungeon of them all: the INFINICRYPT!!!

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2886320/Infinicrypt/
